chunks: 2431 - Bakr ibn Salih narrated from Sulayman ibn Ja'far, from Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام, who said:

"Whoever sets out alone on a journey, let him say: 'Whatever Allah wills. There is no power and no strength except with Allah. O Allah, bring comfort to my loneliness, help me in my solitude, and discharge my absence.'

key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; a direct form of supplication
key_terms.غَيْبَتِي: my absence from those left behind
key_terms.لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّه: a declaration that no change in state and no strength exist except through Allah
key_terms.مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ: an expression affirming that all occurs by Allah's will
key_terms.وَحْشَتِي: my loneliness or feeling of desolation

ai.seo_question: What should a person say when traveling alone according to Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a du'a for one who travels alone, combining reliance upon Allah with a request for companionship, aid, and protection. It reflects the spiritual etiquette of travel and turning to Allah in moments of isolation and vulnerability.
